scripts.setup: pnpm install && node scripts/run.mjs ensure-env && pnpm --filter @kb/api run setup
scripts.dev: node scripts/run.mjs exec turbo run dev --filter=@kb/api --filter=@kb/web --filter=@kb/website
scripts.dev:product: node scripts/run.mjs exec turbo run dev --filter=@kb/api --filter=@kb/web
scripts.build: node scripts/run.mjs exec turbo run build
scripts.lint: node scripts/run.mjs exec turbo run lint
scripts.test: node scripts/run.mjs exec turbo run test
scripts.db:migrate: node scripts/run.mjs venv --cwd apps/api alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:queue-schema: node scripts/run.mjs venv --cwd apps/api procrastinate --app=src.infrastructure.queue.app.app schema --apply
scripts.db:app-role: node scripts/run.mjs psql --set ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -v app_password=@{APP_DB_PASSWORD:kb_app_password} -v db=@{POSTGRES_DB:kb_new} -f apps/api/scripts/create_app_role.sql
scripts.db:seed: node scripts/run.mjs venv --cwd apps/api python scripts/seed_default_kb.py
scripts.worker: node scripts/run.mjs venv --cwd apps/api procrastinate --app=src.infrastructure.queue.app.app worker
scripts.worker:dev: node scripts/run.mjs venv --cwd apps/api watchfiles --target-type command "procrastinate --app=src.infrastructure.queue.app.app worker" src
scripts.db:reset: node scripts/run.mjs psql --set ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "DROP SCHEMA public CASCADE; CREATE SCHEMA public;" && pnpm run db:migrate && pnpm run db:queue-schema && pnpm run db:app-role && pnpm run db:seed
scripts.docker:db:migrate: node scripts/compose.mjs run --rm api alembic upgrade head
scripts.docker:db:queue-schema: node scripts/compose.mjs run --rm api procrastinate --app=src.infrastructure.queue.app.app schema --apply
scripts.docker:db:app-role: node scripts/compose.mjs --stdin apps/api/scripts/create_app_role.sql exec -T db psql -U kb_user -d kb_new -v app_password=@{APP_DB_PASSWORD:kb_app_password} -v db=kb_new
scripts.docker:db:seed: node scripts/compose.mjs run --rm api python scripts/seed_default_kb.py
scripts.docker:db:sql: node scripts/compose.mjs exec db psql -U kb_user -d kb_new
